purpose: Teach: チューナー/チェックポイント/オペレーター/コントローラー/ビデオテープ/サイコロ/バーナー/ホーン

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、創業時、放送局のチューナー機材を自作された
lines.en: Your father — he built the broadcast station's tuner equipment himself, back when he was starting out.
lines.style: Gentle, almost musing. Soft opening. Pace is unhurried, allowing each image to settle. The tone of someone recalling something he's proud of, speaking to someone who would understand.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは事業のチェックポイントを毎月確認された
lines.en: Yes. He would check the business checkpoints every month without fail.
lines.style: Measured affirmation. Steady, respectful tone. Not ceremonial, but grounded — the voice of someone honoring a pattern he inherited. Slight emphasis on the consistency itself.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、若い頃、電話オペレーターと連携された
lines.en: Your father — in those early days, he worked closely with the telephone operators.
lines.style: Soft, nostalgic opening attack. Voice carries a kind of tenderness for a time that's passed. Slight pause after the dash. Unhurried, allowing the specificity to land.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは工場コントローラーの導入を早くされた
lines.en: Yes. He made the decision to bring in factory controllers ahead of anyone else.
lines.style: Steady reflection. Warm undertone of recognition — not lecturing, but acknowledging foresight. Even pace. The voice of someone who inherited both the habit and its consequences.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、社内式典の映像をビデオテープで残された
lines.en: Your father — he made sure to preserve the company ceremonies on videotape.
lines.style: Tender opening. Voice carries the weight of memory and care. Unhurried pacing. Slight exhale before the verb, as if touching something kept safe.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは社員研修にサイコロゲームを取り入れた
lines.en: Yes. He introduced dice games into the staff training sessions.
lines.style: Calm affirmation. Tone suggests quiet appreciation for an unconventional choice. Steady pace. The voice of someone who understands what that detail reveals about the man.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、工場のバーナーの火力管理に厳しかった
lines.en: Your father — he was strict about the flame control on the factory burners.
lines.style: Voice carries quiet weight. Opening word steady and clear. Slight emphasis on the precision that demanded it. Unhurried. The tone of someone naming something essential.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは緊急時のホーンを自ら鳴らされた
lines.en: Yes. When an emergency came, he would sound the horn himself.
lines.style: Quiet authority. Clear, grounded tone. Slight emphasis on the personal responsibility in 「自ら」. Closing with gentle finality — the weight of that choice, honored and understood.
